The '''''Avarice''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[X2]] breached the ship, found his "brother" [[X1]], and dueled him. The ''Avarice'' was ultimately destroyed during the battle via explosives planted by [[Grey Squadron]].
